verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .

verses.original: דַּבֵּר֙ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ כִּ֣י תָבֹ֗אוּ אֶל־ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם אֶ֙רֶץ֙ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י נֹתֵ֥ן לָכֶֽם׃ מוֹשְׁבֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·’ā·mar·tā kî ṯā·ḇō·’ū ’el- ’ă·lê·hem ’e·reṣ ’ă·šer ’ă·nî nō·ṯên lā·ḵem mō·wō·šə·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: Speak to the Israelites . . . and tell them After you enter . . . . . . the land that I am giving you as a home

verses.original: וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֨ם אִשֶּׁ֤ה לַֽיהוָה֙ מִן־ הַבָּקָ֖ר א֥וֹ מִן־ הַצֹּֽאן׃ לַעֲשׂ֞וֹת נִיחֹ֙חַ֙ רֵ֤יחַ לַֽיהוָ֔ה עֹלָ֣ה אוֹ־ זֶ֔בַח לְפַלֵּא־ נֶ֙דֶר֙ א֣וֹ בִנְדָבָ֔ה א֖וֹ בְּמֹעֲדֵיכֶ֑ם
verses.transliteration: wa·‘ă·śî·ṯem ’iš·šeh Yah·weh min- hab·bā·qār ’ōw min- haṣ·ṣōn la·‘ă·śō·wṯ nî·ḥō·aḥ rê·aḥ Yah·weh ‘ō·lāh ’ōw- ze·ḇaḥ lə·p̄al·lê- ne·ḏer ’ōw ḇin·ḏā·ḇāh ’ōw bə·mō·‘ă·ḏê·ḵem
verses.literal: and you present a food offering to the LORD from the herd or . . . flock to produce a pleasing aroma to the LORD either a burnt offering or a sacrifice for a special vow or freewill offering or appointed feast

verses.original: וְהִקְרִ֛יב קָרְבָּנ֖וֹ לַֽיהוָ֑ה הַמַּקְרִ֥יב מִנְחָה֙ עִשָּׂר֔וֹן סֹ֣לֶת בָּל֕וּל בִּרְבִעִ֥ית הַהִ֖ין שָֽׁמֶן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiq·rîḇ qā·rə·bā·nōw Yah·weh ham·maq·rîḇ min·ḥāh ‘iś·śā·rō·wn sō·leṯ bā·lūl bir·ḇi·‘îṯ ha·hîn šā·men
verses.literal: then the one presenting his offering to the LORD shall also present a grain offering of a tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with a quarter hin of olive oil

verses.original: עַל־ הָעֹלָ֖ה א֣וֹ לַזָּ֑בַח הָאֶחָֽד׃ לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה רְבִיעִ֣ית הַהִ֔ין וְיַ֤יִן לַנֶּ֙סֶךְ֙
verses.transliteration: ‘al- hā·‘ō·lāh ’ōw laz·zā·ḇaḥ hā·’e·ḥāḏ lak·ke·ḇeś ta·‘ă·śeh rə·ḇî·‘îṯ ha·hîn wə·ya·yin lan·ne·seḵ
verses.literal: With the burnt offering or sacrifice of each lamb you are to prepare a quarter hin of wine as a drink offering

verses.original: א֤וֹ לָאַ֙יִל֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה מִנְחָ֔ה שְׁנֵ֣י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֑ים סֹ֖לֶת בְּלוּלָ֥ה שְׁלִשִׁ֥ית הַהִֽין׃ בַשֶּׁ֖מֶן
verses.transliteration: ’ōw lā·’a·yil ta·‘ă·śeh min·ḥāh šə·nê ‘eś·rō·nîm sō·leṯ bə·lū·lāh šə·li·šîṯ ha·hîn ḇaš·še·men
verses.literal: - With a ram you are to prepare a grain offering of two-tenths [of an ephah] . . . of fine flour mixed with a third of a hin of olive oil

verses.original: תַּקְרִ֥יב שְׁלִשִׁ֣ית הַהִ֑ין וְיַ֥יִן לַנֶּ֖סֶךְ נִיחֹ֖חַ רֵֽיחַ־ לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: taq·rîḇ šə·li·šîṯ ha·hîn wə·ya·yin lan·ne·seḵ nî·ḥō·aḥ rê·aḥ- Yah·weh
verses.literal: [and] a third of a hin of wine as a drink offering a pleasing aroma to the LORD

verses.original: וְכִֽי־ תַעֲשֶׂ֥ה בֶן־ בָּקָ֖ר עֹלָ֣ה אוֹ־ זָ֑בַח לְפַלֵּא־ נֶ֥דֶר אֽוֹ־ שְׁלָמִ֖ים לַֽיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî- ṯa·‘ă·śeh ḇen- bā·qār ‘ō·lāh ’ōw- zā·ḇaḥ lə·p̄al·lê- ne·ḏer ’ōw- šə·lā·mîm Yah·weh
verses.literal: When you prepare a young bull as a burnt offering or sacrifice to fulfill a vow or as a peace offering to the LORD

verses.original: וְהִקְרִ֤יב עַל־ בֶּן־ הַבָּקָר֙ מִנְחָ֔ה שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה עֶשְׂרֹנִ֑ים סֹ֖לֶת בָּל֥וּל חֲצִ֥י הַהִֽין׃ בַּשֶּׁ֖מֶן
verses.transliteration: wə·hiq·rîḇ ‘al- ben- hab·bā·qār min·ḥāh šə·lō·šāh ‘eś·rō·nîm sō·leṯ bā·lūl ḥă·ṣî ha·hîn baš·še·men
verses.literal: present with . . . the bull a grain offering of three-tenths [of an ephah] . . . of fine flour mixed with half a hin of olive oil

verses.original: תַּקְרִ֥יב חֲצִ֣י הַהִ֑ין וְיַ֛יִן לַנֶּ֖סֶךְ אִשֵּׁ֥ה נִיחֹ֖חַ רֵֽיחַ־ לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: taq·rîḇ ḥă·ṣî ha·hîn wə·ya·yin lan·ne·seḵ ’iš·šêh nî·ḥō·aḥ rê·aḥ- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Also present half a hin of wine as a drink offering It is a food offering a pleasing aroma to the LORD

verses.original: כָּ֣כָה יֵעָשֶׂ֗ה הָֽאֶחָ֔ד לַשּׁוֹר֙ א֖וֹ לָאַ֣יִל הָאֶחָ֑ד אֽוֹ־ לַשֶּׂ֥ה בַכְּבָשִׂ֖ים א֥וֹ בָעִזִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kā·ḵāh yê·‘ā·śeh hā·’e·ḥāḏ laš·šō·wr ’ōw lā·’a·yil hā·’e·ḥāḏ ’ōw- laś·śeh ḇak·kə·ḇā·śîm ’ōw ḇā·‘iz·zîm
verses.literal: This is to be done for each bull ram . . . . . . lamb . . . or goat

verses.original: כָּ֛כָה תַּעֲשׂ֑וּ תַּעֲשׂ֥וּ לָאֶחָ֖ד כְּמִסְפָּרָֽם׃ אֲשֶׁ֣ר כַּמִּסְפָּ֖ר
verses.transliteration: kā·ḵāh ta·‘ă·śū ta·‘ă·śū lā·’e·ḥāḏ kə·mis·pā·rām ’ă·šer kam·mis·pār
verses.literal: This is how you must prepare . . . each one . . . no matter how many

verses.original: כָּל־ הָאֶזְרָ֥ח יַעֲשֶׂה־ אֵ֑לֶּה כָּ֖כָה אֶת־ לְהַקְרִ֛יב אִשֵּׁ֥ה נִיחֹ֖חַ רֵֽיחַ־ לַֽיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- hā·’ez·rāḥ ya·‘ă·śeh- ’êl·leh kā·ḵāh ’eṯ- lə·haq·rîḇ ’iš·šêh nî·ḥō·aḥ rê·aḥ- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Everyone who is native-born shall prepare these things in this way - when he presents a food offering as a pleasing aroma to the LORD

verses.original: לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וְכִֽי־ גֵּ֜ר יָגוּר֩ אִתְּכֶ֨ם א֤וֹ אֲשֶֽׁר־ בְּתֽוֹכְכֶם֙ וְעָשָׂ֛ה אִשֵּׁ֥ה נִיחֹ֖חַ רֵֽיחַ־ לַיהוָ֑ה תַּעֲשׂ֖וּ כֵּ֥ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר יַעֲשֶֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḏō·rō·ṯê·ḵem wə·ḵî- gêr yā·ḡūr ’it·tə·ḵem ’ōw ’ă·šer- bə·ṯō·wḵ·ḵem wə·‘ā·śāh ’iš·šêh nî·ḥō·aḥ rê·aḥ- Yah·weh ta·‘ă·śū kên ka·’ă·šer ya·‘ă·śeh
verses.literal: And for the generations to come if a foreigner residing with you or someone else among you wants to prepare a food offering as a pleasing aroma to the LORD he is to do . . . exactly as you do

verses.original: הַקָּהָ֕ל אַחַ֛ת חֻקָּ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם וְלַגֵּ֣ר הַגָּ֑ר עוֹלָם֙ חֻקַּ֤ת לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם כָּכֶ֛ם כַּגֵּ֥ר יִהְיֶ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: haq·qā·hāl ’a·ḥaṯ ḥuq·qāh lā·ḵem wə·lag·gêr hag·gār ‘ō·w·lām ḥuq·qaṯ lə·ḏō·rō·ṯê·ḵem kā·ḵem kag·gêr yih·yeh lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: The assembly is to have the same statute both for you and for the foreign resident . . . it is a permanent statute for the generations to come You and the foreigner shall be the same before the LORD

verses.original: אַחַ֛ת תּוֹרָ֥ה אֶחָ֖ד וּמִשְׁפָּ֥ט יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֑ם וְלַגֵּ֖ר הַגָּ֥ר אִתְּכֶֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥaṯ tō·w·rāh ’e·ḥāḏ ū·miš·pāṭ yih·yeh lā·ḵem wə·lag·gêr hag·gār ’it·tə·ḵem
verses.literal: The same law and the same ordinance will apply both to you and to the foreigner residing with you

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’el- way·ḏab·bêr mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD . . . said to Moses . . .

verses.original: דַּבֵּר֙ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ בְּבֹֽאֲכֶם֙ אֶל־ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֛י מֵבִ֥יא אֶתְכֶ֖ם שָֽׁמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·’ā·mar·tā bə·ḇō·’ă·ḵem ’el- ’ă·lê·hem hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer ’ă·nî mê·ḇî ’eṯ·ḵem šām·māh
verses.literal: Speak to the Israelites . . . and tell them When you enter . . . . . . the land to which I am bringing you - -

verses.original: בַּאֲכָלְכֶ֖ם מִלֶּ֣חֶם הָאָ֑רֶץ וְהָיָ֕ה תָּרִ֥ימוּ תְרוּמָ֖ה לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ba·’ă·ḵā·lə·ḵem mil·le·ḥem hā·’ā·reṣ wə·hā·yāh tā·rî·mū ṯə·rū·māh Yah·weh
verses.literal: and you eat the food of the land . . . you shall lift up an offering to the LORD

verses.original: רֵאשִׁית֙ עֲרִסֹ֣תֵכֶ֔ם תָּרִ֣ימוּ חַלָּ֖ה תְרוּמָ֑ה תָּרִ֥ימוּ אֹתָֽהּ׃ כֵּ֖ן כִּתְרוּמַ֣ת גֹּ֔רֶן
verses.transliteration: rê·šîṯ ‘ă·ri·sō·ṯê·ḵem tā·rî·mū ḥal·lāh ṯə·rū·māh tā·rî·mū ’ō·ṯāh kên kiṯ·rū·maṯ gō·ren
verses.literal: From the first of your dough you are to lift up a cake as a contribution offer it just like an offering from the threshing floor

verses.original: לְדֹרֹ֖תֵיכֶֽם׃ס תִּתְּנ֥וּ לַיהוָ֖ה תְּרוּמָ֑ה מֵרֵאשִׁית֙ עֲרִסֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם
verses.transliteration: lə·ḏō·rō·ṯê·ḵem tit·tə·nū Yah·weh tə·rū·māh mê·rê·šîṯ ‘ă·ri·sō·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: Throughout your generations you are to give the LORD an offering from the first of your dough

verses.original: וְכִ֣י תִשְׁגּ֔וּ וְלֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֔וּ אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הָאֵ֑לֶּה הַמִּצְוֺ֖ת אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֖ה דִּבֶּ֥ר אֶל־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî ṯiš·gū wə·lō ṯa·‘ă·śū ’êṯ kāl- hā·’êl·leh ham·miṣ·wōṯ ’ă·šer- Yah·weh dib·ber ’el- mō·šeh
verses.literal: Now if you stray unintentionally and do not obey - all these commandments that the LORD has spoken to Moses

verses.original: אֵת֩ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהוָ֛ה אֲלֵיכֶ֖ם צִוָּ֧ה בְּיַד־ מֹשֶׁ֑ה מִן־ הַיּ֞וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהוָ֛ה צִוָּ֧ה וָהָ֖לְאָה לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer Yah·weh ’ă·lê·ḵem ṣiw·wāh bə·yaḏ- mō·šeh min- hay·yō·wm ’ă·šer Yah·weh ṣiw·wāh wā·hā·lə·’āh lə·ḏō·rō·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: - all that the LORD . . . has commanded you through Moses from the day - the LORD gave them and continuing through the generations to come

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה אִ֣ם נֶעֶשְׂתָ֣ה לִשְׁגָגָה֒ מֵעֵינֵ֣י הָעֵדָה֮ כָל־ הָעֵדָ֡ה וְעָשׂ֣וּ אֶחָ֨ד פַּ֣ר בֶּן־ בָּקָר֩ לְעֹלָ֜ה נִיחֹ֙חַ֙ לְרֵ֤יחַ לַֽיהוָ֔ה וּמִנְחָת֥וֹ וְנִסְכּ֖וֹ כַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט אֶחָ֖ד וּשְׂעִיר־ עִזִּ֥ים לְחַטָּֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ’im ne·‘eś·ṯāh liš·ḡā·ḡāh mê·‘ê·nê hā·‘ê·ḏāh ḵāl hā·‘ê·ḏāh wə·‘ā·śū ’e·ḥāḏ par ben- bā·qār lə·‘ō·lāh nî·ḥō·aḥ lə·rê·aḥ Yah·weh ū·min·ḥā·ṯōw wə·nis·kōw kam·miš·pāṭ ’e·ḥāḏ ū·śə·‘îr- ‘iz·zîm lə·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ
verses.literal: - and if it was done unintentionally without the knowledge of the congregation then the whole congregation is to prepare one young bull . . . . . . as a burnt offering a pleasing aroma to the LORD with its grain offering and drink offering according to the regulation and one male goat . . . as a sin offering

verses.original: הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וְכִפֶּ֣ר עַֽל־ כָּל־ עֲדַ֛ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְנִסְלַ֣ח לָהֶ֑ם כִּֽי־ הִ֔וא שְׁגָגָ֣ה וְהֵם֩ הֵבִ֨יאוּ אֶת־ לַֽיהוָ֗ה קָרְבָּנָ֜ם אִשֶּׁ֣ה וְחַטָּאתָ֛ם לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה עַל־ שִׁגְגָתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hak·kō·hên wə·ḵip·per ‘al- kāl- ‘ă·ḏaṯ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·nis·laḥ lā·hem kî- hî šə·ḡā·ḡāh wə·hêm hê·ḇî·’ū ’eṯ- Yah·weh qā·rə·bā·nām ’iš·šeh wə·ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯām lip̄·nê Yah·weh ‘al- šiḡ·ḡā·ṯām
verses.literal: The priest is to make atonement for the whole congregation . . . of Israel so that they may be forgiven for [the sin] was unintentional and they have brought - to the LORD vvv a food offering and a sin offering [presented] before the LORD for their unintentional sin

verses.original: לְכָל־ עֲדַת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְלַגֵּ֖ר הַגָּ֣ר בְּתוֹכָ֑ם וְנִסְלַ֗ח כִּ֥י לְכָל־ הָעָ֖ם בִּשְׁגָגָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: lə·ḵāl ‘ă·ḏaṯ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·lag·gêr hag·gār bə·ṯō·w·ḵām wə·nis·laḥ kî lə·ḵāl hā·‘ām biš·ḡā·ḡāh
verses.literal: Then the whole congregation . . . of Israel and the foreigners residing among them will be forgiven since it happened to all the people unintentionally

verses.original: וְאִם־ אַחַ֖ת נֶ֥פֶשׁ תֶּחֱטָ֣א בִשְׁגָגָ֑ה וְהִקְרִ֛יבָה בַּת־ שְׁנָתָ֖הּ עֵ֥ז לְחַטָּֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- ’a·ḥaṯ ne·p̄eš te·ḥĕ·ṭā ḇiš·ḡā·ḡāh wə·hiq·rî·ḇāh baṯ- šə·nā·ṯāh ‘êz lə·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ
verses.literal: Also, if one person sins unintentionally he is to present a year-old . . . female goat as a sin offering

verses.original: הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וְכִפֶּ֣ר לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה עַל־ הַנֶּ֧פֶשׁ בִשְׁגָגָ֖ה הַשֹּׁגֶ֛גֶת בְּחֶטְאָ֥ה לְכַפֵּ֥ר עָלָ֖יו וְנִסְלַ֥ח לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hak·kō·hên wə·ḵip·per lip̄·nê Yah·weh ‘al- han·ne·p̄eš ḇiš·ḡā·ḡāh haš·šō·ḡe·ḡeṯ bə·ḥeṭ·’āh lə·ḵap·pêr ‘ā·lāw wə·nis·laḥ lōw
verses.literal: And the priest shall make atonement before the LORD on behalf of the person who erred by sinning unintentionally . . . and when atonement has been made for him he will be forgiven

verses.original: לָכֶ֔ם יִהְיֶ֣ה אַחַת֙ תּוֹרָ֤ה לָעֹשֶׂ֖ה בִּשְׁגָגָֽה׃ הָֽאֶזְרָח֙ בִּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְלַגֵּ֖ר הַגָּ֣ר בְּתוֹכָ֑ם
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵem yih·yeh ’a·ḥaṯ tō·w·rāh lā·‘ō·śeh biš·ḡā·ḡāh hā·’ez·rāḥ biḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·lag·gêr hag·gār bə·ṯō·w·ḵām
verses.literal: You shall have the same law for the one who acts in error whether he is a native-born Israelite . . . or a foreigner residing among you

verses.original: וְהַנֶּ֜פֶשׁ אֲשֶֽׁר־ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה׀ בְּיָ֣ד רָמָ֗ה מִן־ הָֽאֶזְרָח֙ וּמִן־ הַגֵּ֔ר אֶת־ מְגַדֵּ֑ף יְהוָ֖ה ה֣וּא הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה מִקֶּ֥רֶב עַמָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·han·ne·p̄eš ’ă·šer- ta·‘ă·śeh bə·yāḏ rā·māh min- hā·’ez·rāḥ ū·min- hag·gêr ’eṯ- mə·ḡad·dêp̄ Yah·weh hū han·ne·p̄eš ha·hi·w wə·niḵ·rə·ṯāh miq·qe·reḇ ‘am·māh
verses.literal: But the person who vvv sins defiantly . . . whether a native or foreigner - blasphemes the LORD That person . . . shall be cut off from among his people

verses.original: הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא הִכָּרֵ֧ת׀ תִּכָּרֵ֛ת כִּ֤י בָּזָ֔ה דְבַר־ יְהוָה֙ וְאֶת־ הֵפַ֑ר מִצְוָת֖וֹ עֲוֺנָ֥ה בָֽהּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: han·ne·p̄eš ha·hi·w hik·kā·rêṯ tik·kā·rêṯ kî bā·zāh ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh wə·’eṯ- hê·p̄ar miṣ·wā·ṯōw ‘ă·wō·nāh ḇāh
verses.literal: He . . . shall certainly be cut off . . . because he has despised the word of the LORD and broken His commandment his guilt [remains] on him

verses.original: בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וַיִּהְי֥וּ בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר אִ֛ישׁ וַֽיִּמְצְא֗וּ מְקֹשֵׁ֥שׁ עֵצִ֖ים הַשַּׁבָּֽת׃ בְּי֥וֹם
verses.transliteration: ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl way·yih·yū bam·miḏ·bār ’îš way·yim·ṣə·’ū mə·qō·šêš ‘ê·ṣîm haš·šab·bāṯ bə·yō·wm
verses.literal: While the Israelites . . . were in the wilderness a man was found gathering wood on the Sabbath day

verses.original: הַמֹּצְאִ֥ים אֹת֖וֹ מְקֹשֵׁ֣שׁ עֵצִ֑ים וַיַּקְרִ֣יבוּ אֹת֔וֹ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁה֙ וְאֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֔ן וְאֶ֖ל כָּל־ הָעֵדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ham·mō·ṣə·’îm ’ō·ṯōw mə·qō·šêš ‘ê·ṣîm way·yaq·rî·ḇū ’ō·ṯōw ’el- mō·šeh wə·’el- ’a·hă·rōn wə·’el kāl- hā·‘ê·ḏāh
verses.literal: Those who found [the man] gathering wood brought him to Moses . . . Aaron . . . and the whole congregation

verses.original: כִּ֚י לֹ֣א פֹרַ֔שׁ מַה־ יֵּעָשֶׂ֖ה לֽוֹ׃ס וַיַּנִּ֥יחוּ אֹת֖וֹ בַּמִּשְׁמָ֑ר
verses.transliteration: kî lō p̄ō·raš mah- yê·‘ā·śeh lōw way·yan·nî·ḥū ’ō·ṯōw bam·miš·mār
verses.literal: and because it had not been declared what should be done to him they placed him in custody

verses.original: יְהוָה֙ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה הָאִ֑ישׁ מ֥וֹת יוּמַ֖ת כָּל־ הָ֣עֵדָ֔ה רָג֨וֹם בָֽאֲבָנִים֙ אֹת֤וֹ מִח֖וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’el- mō·šeh hā·’îš mō·wṯ yū·maṯ kāl- hā·‘ê·ḏāh rā·ḡō·wm ḇā·’ă·ḇā·nîm ’ō·ṯōw mi·ḥūṣ lam·ma·ḥă·neh
verses.literal: And the LORD said to Moses The man must surely be put to death . . . The whole congregation is to stone . . . him outside the camp

verses.original: כָּל־ הָעֵדָ֗ה אֶל־ וַיֹּצִ֨יאוּ אֹת֜וֹ מִחוּץ֙ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וַיִּרְגְּמ֥וּ אֹת֛וֹ בָּאֲבָנִ֖ים וַיָּמֹ֑ת כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ צִוָּ֥ה מֹשֶֽׁה׃פ
verses.transliteration: kāl- hā·‘ê·ḏāh ’el- way·yō·ṣî·’ū ’ō·ṯōw mi·ḥūṣ lam·ma·ḥă·neh way·yir·gə·mū ’ō·ṯōw bā·’ă·ḇā·nîm way·yā·mōṯ ka·’ă·šer Yah·weh ’eṯ- ṣiw·wāh mō·šeh
verses.literal: So the whole congregation . . . took [the man] outside the camp and stoned - him to death as the LORD - had commanded Moses

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: And the LORD said to Moses . . .

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל־ בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם לְדֹרֹתָ֑ם וְעָשׂ֨וּ לָהֶ֥ם צִיצִ֛ת עַל־ כַּנְפֵ֥י בִגְדֵיהֶ֖ם וְנָֽתְנ֛וּ תְּכֵֽלֶת׃ פְּתִ֥יל עַל־ צִיצִ֥ת הַכָּנָ֖ף
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem lə·ḏō·rō·ṯām wə·‘ā·śū lā·hem ṣî·ṣiṯ ‘al- kan·p̄ê ḇiḡ·ḏê·hem wə·nā·ṯə·nū tə·ḵê·leṯ pə·ṯîl ‘al- ṣî·ṣiṯ hak·kā·nāp̄
verses.literal: Speak to the Israelites . . . and tell them that throughout the generations to come they are to make for themselves tassels for the corners of their garments with a blue cord on each tassel . . .

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה לָכֶם֮ לְצִיצִת֒ וּרְאִיתֶ֣ם אֹת֗וֹ וּזְכַרְתֶּם֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ מִצְוֺ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑ם וְלֹֽא־ זֹנִ֖ים אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃ תָתֻ֜רוּ אַחֲרֵ֤י לְבַבְכֶם֙ וְאַחֲרֵ֣י עֵֽינֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־ אַתֶּ֥ם
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh lā·ḵem lə·ṣî·ṣiṯ ū·rə·’î·ṯem ’ō·ṯōw ū·zə·ḵar·tem ’eṯ- kāl- miṣ·wōṯ Yah·weh wa·‘ă·śî·ṯem ’ō·ṯām wə·lō- zō·nîm ’a·ḥă·rê·hem ṯā·ṯu·rū ’a·ḥă·rê lə·ḇaḇ·ḵem wə·’a·ḥă·rê ‘ê·nê·ḵem ’ă·šer- ’at·tem
verses.literal: These will serve as tassels for you to look at - so that you may remember - all the commandments of the LORD that you may obey them and not prostitute yourselves . . . by following . . . your own heart . . . and your own eyes - -

verses.original: לְמַ֣עַן תִּזְכְּר֔וּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֶת־ כָּל־ מִצְוֺתָ֑י וִהְיִיתֶ֥ם קְדֹשִׁ֖ים לֵֽאלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘an tiz·kə·rū wa·‘ă·śî·ṯem ’eṯ- kāl- miṣ·wō·ṯāy wih·yî·ṯem qə·ḏō·šîm lê·lō·hê·ḵem
verses.literal: Then you will remember and obey - all My commandments and you will be holy to your God

verses.original: אֲנִ֞י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹצֵ֤אתִי אֶתְכֶם֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם לִהְי֥וֹת לָכֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִ֑ים אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem ’ă·šer hō·w·ṣê·ṯî ’eṯ·ḵem mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim lih·yō·wṯ lā·ḵem lê·lō·hîm ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem
verses.literal: I am the LORD your God who brought you out - of the land of Egypt to be your God I am the LORD your God
